name: HDFC Bank Ltd
about: HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024. As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges. [1]

cash.note: For lenders, operating cash flow mostly reflects loan-book growth, so conversion ratios are not meaningful.

flags.text: Share capital up 103% in three years: new shares from an issue, a merger or a bonus. Only the first two dilute

business.what: HDFC Bank is an Indian bank that raises deposits (CASA, term, FCNR(B)) and lends to retail, business banking (MSME), corporate and agri clients, including personal, vehicle, gold and credit card products. It earns mainly the spread between lending yields and funding costs.

ledger.promise: Net interest margin in FY27 to be positive but modest
ledger.quote: It's positive, but modest given that, whatever preferences the customers have.
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 call says Q2 is the margin bottom and guides only 'neutral to positive' from here, citing an FCNR funding headwind. Margins fell in H1 FY27 before any recovery.

ledger.promise: Further fall in cost of funds as remaining time deposits reprice over 5-6 quarters
ledger.quote: there will be further reduction coming on the residual because the time deposit takes 5, 6 quarters or so to go.
ledger.actual: Window runs to about Q3-Q4 FY27. Q2 FY27 call cites a full-quarter FCNR(B) cost headwind and Q2 as the margin bottom. Cost of funds is not reported.

ledger.promise: Cost-of-funds milestones from replacing borrowings to show in July-September 2026
ledger.quote: And you will see in the month of July, August, September, we have certain milestones.
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 call reports no milestones and calls Q2 the margin bottom. Borrowings rose from 588,485 (FY26) to 594,144 (latest).

ledger.promise: 100-125 bps saving by replacing Rs 40,000-50,000 crore of maturing borrowings with time deposits over the next couple of years
ledger.quote: So you can pick up 100 basis points, 125 basis points depending on the source of the time deposit.
ledger.actual: Borrowings went up by 5,659 to 594,144 from 588,485 at FY26. They had fallen from 730,615 (FY24). No rate data given.

ledger.quote: I think you will see the kind of growth that we have used to pre-merger coming back.
ledger.actual: No deadline given and no pre-merger data here. Revenue grew 3.6% in FY26 and 9.4% YoY in Q2 FY27. PAT grew 7.9% in FY26 and 5.8% YoY in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Business banking (MSME) loan growth of 18-21% in FY27
ledger.quote: that will continue to also be in that range of 18% to 20%, 21%, depending upon, obviously, some of the developments in the economy.
ledger.actual: No segment loan data. Q2 FY27 call says the change in growth will show 'across the next 2 quarters' as retail and MSME volumes grow, with no number.

ledger.promise: Visible change in loan growth trend as retail and MSME volumes grow, across the next 2 quarters
ledger.quote: going forward, across the next 2 quarters, you will see that change coming through as we also grow the volumes in retail and MSME.
ledger.actual: Deadline is Q4 FY27. Q2 FY27 revenue was 95,132, up 5.0% QoQ and 9.4% YoY.

ledger.promise: Margin trajectory upward from Q3 FY27, with the October 25 bps repo cut largely absorbed by December
ledger.quote: The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.
ledger.actual: Q3 FY27 results are not yet available.

ledger.promise: Profit growth at or above balance sheet growth over the longer term
ledger.quote: We do think that in the longer term that the profit growth should be at or above the balance sheet growth.
ledger.actual: No balance sheet size data. TTM PAT 83,685 is 5.6% above FY26 PAT of 79,219. Q2 FY27 PAT grew 5.8% YoY.

ledger.promise: Technology-driven operating leverage to lift return on assets over 1-3 years
ledger.quote: will be a key driver to enhance return on asset over the next 1, 2, 3 years.
ledger.actual: No asset data to compute ROA. The window runs to FY29.

ledger.promise: Board to decide on full-time or non-executive chairman within 3 months
ledger.quote: There is a full 3-month period during which period of time the Board will meet, take a call on who should be the full-time or the Non-Executive Chairman
ledger.actual: No later call in these materials reports a chairman decision.

ledger.promise: Sashidhar Jagdishan reappointed for a three-year term
ledger.quote: he's going to be there for next three years which is going to be one of our best years in the history of the bank
ledger.actual: On the Q2 FY27 call Jagdishan says a new CEO, Anup, will unveil his strategy. That points to a leadership change within about 7 months, but his own role is not stated.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: The main promise that can be checked so far, positive FY27 margins, was softened within two quarters to 'neutral to positive' after Q2 FY27, and the cost-of-funds benefit from replacing borrowings was delayed, while borrowings actually rose by 5,659. Most other commitments, such as growth returning to pre-merger levels, ROA and MSME growth, are open-ended or cannot be checked with this data, and the 'three years' leadership statement sits awkwardly next to a new CEO by Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Pre-merger growth is coming back, and the next three years will be 'one of our best years in the history of the bank'.
Cost of funds will improve as Rs 40,000-50,000 crore of borrowings is replaced with cheaper time deposits, with milestones in July-September 2026.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Borrowings fell from 730,615 (FY24) to 588,485 (FY26) but then rose to 594,144, up 5,659. Q2 FY27 call calls Q2 the margin bottom.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q2 FY27 margins under pressure from FCNR costs, large deposit outflows and retail back-book runoff.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Even so, Q2 FY27 revenue rose 5.0% QoQ to 95,132 (9.4% YoY), PBT rose 5.4% QoQ to 28,663, and PAT of 21,537 is the highest quarter in the table.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Profit growth should be at or above balance sheet growth over the longer term.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q1 FY27 PAT fell 3.3% QoQ (21,074 to 20,383). TTM PAT of 83,685 is up 5.6% on FY26. Balance sheet size is not given, so no comparison is possible.

bull.point: Revenue growth picked up in Q2 FY27
bull.evidence: Revenue was 95,132 in Q2 FY27, up 9.4% YoY and 5.0% QoQ. Q1 FY27 had grown 3.7% YoY, and FY26 3.6% for the full year.

bull.point: Management has named a margin bottom and a near-term trigger
bull.evidence: Q2 FY27 is called the bottom, with the trajectory upward from Q3. The October 25 bps repo cut should be largely absorbed by December.

bull.point: Wholesale borrowings have come down a lot since FY24
bull.evidence: Borrowings fell from 730,615 (FY24) to 588,485 (FY26), down 142,130 or 19.5%. A further 40,000-50,000 crore is due to mature and be replaced at a 100-125 bps lower cost.
bull.source: reported numbers; Q1 FY27 call p12

bear.point: Margin guidance was cut within two quarters
bear.evidence: 'Positive, but modest' for FY27 (Q4 FY26 call p15) became 'neutral to positive' after margins bottomed in Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27 call p10).

bear.point: The borrowing-replacement benefit is delayed, and borrowings went up
bear.evidence: Q1 FY27 blamed documentation and approvals for the delay. Borrowings then rose from 588,485 to 594,144. Q2 FY27 also reports large one-off deposit outflows and pressure on LCR.
bear.source: Q1 FY27 call p8; Q2 FY27 call p15; reported numbers

bear.point: Profit growth is in single digits, and leadership plans are changing
bear.evidence: Q2 FY27 PAT grew 5.8% YoY. A new CEO is yet to unveil his strategy (Q2 FY27 call p7), only months after the 'next three years' statement on Jagdishan (Q3 FY26 call p6).
bear.source: reported numbers; Q2 FY27 call p7
